title: Requirements
summary: All applicants seeking employment at Zura Spa must meet these personal, work, dress-code, ethics and integrity requirements.

sections.title: Employment Requirements
paragraphs: All applicants seeking employment at Zura Spa must meet the following requirements.

sections.title: 1. Personal Requirements
list: Must be female.
Must not be older than 24 years.
Must be able to communicate effectively in English.
Must be honest, trustworthy, respectful and well-mannered.
Must be humble, teachable and genuinely willing to learn.
Must maintain professionalism, discretion and confidentiality at all times.

sections.title: 2. Work Commitment
list: Must be hardworking and genuinely willing to work.
Must be available to work a minimum of four days per week.
Must value punctuality and consistently report to work on time.
Must be willing to follow all company standards, policies, procedures and professional guidelines.
Must be receptive to instructions, corrections, training and continuous improvement.

sections.title: 3. Dress Code and Personal Work Kit
paragraphs: Must be willing to purchase and maintain the approved Zura Spa work attire:
list: Navy blue medical scrubs
Crocs footwear

sections.title: Personal work kit
paragraphs: Must have a personal work kit containing:
list: Perfume or body fragrance
Sweets or breath mints
Tissue
Wet wipes
Lip gloss
Sanitary pads
sections.closing: Must maintain excellent personal hygiene, cleanliness and professional grooming.

sections.title: 4. Professional Ethics and Boundaries
list: Must strictly maintain professional boundaries with all clients.
Must never offer, solicit, agree to or participate in sexual services, including happy endings, under any circumstances.
Must protect clients' privacy and keep all client information, conversations and spa activities confidential.
Must not engage in gossip, careless conversations or the unauthorised disclosure of sensitive information.
Must treat clients, colleagues and management with courtesy, dignity and respect.

sections.title: 5. Accountability and Integrity
list: Must take responsibility for personal actions and professional conduct.
Must promptly report complaints, mistakes, misconduct, unusual incidents or operational concerns to management.
Must never conceal, misrepresent or cover up incidents, errors or violations of company policies.
Must be willing to cooperate with management in resolving issues and maintaining the spa's standards.

sections.title: Our Expectations
paragraphs: At Zura Spa, we value professionalism, integrity, confidentiality, respect, excellence and a genuine willingness to learn.
Every team member is expected to uphold these values and contribute positively to the experience of our clients and the reputation of the spa.

remember: Professionalism, integrity, confidentiality, respect, excellence and a genuine willingness to learn.
